Voice shutdown now allows the provider's existing close and final-event I/O windows before bounded transcript finalization. This keeps late terminal events available while retaining a hard shutdown deadline.

- Routine tools omit unused hook schema definitions from list and custom-event operations; typed routine and subscription schemas retain all referenced definitions.
- Computer-control guidance distinguishes the headed browser's first observation-only evaluation from the headless browser's first executing evaluation.
- Bundled tool descriptions clarify file preservation, automatic image delivery, asynchronous completion and chat-stop verification.

Protocol 92, config version 28 and checkpoint formats are unchanged from 0.16.30. No new state conversion is required. Binary archives include the pinned cloudflared runtime, manuals and licenses.
